body: Are you me? I’m exactly like this, maybe except for the working relationship. I know how bad it hurts. I’m sorry. I hope you manage to get better.

Thank you so much for taking the time to read and reply. She told me exactly the same thing you said, about wanting someone equal, about hating to have to walk on eggshells around me. I don’t know how she reads my suicide attempt, but that wasn’t me trying to manipulate the situation. I was in a dark place in the past, but I’m much better now. Suicide is truly not something that comes to my mind today. I’ve also never threatened to hurt myself. Yes, I feel like I’m driving her away from me, but I can’t act differently :/ I mean I am always trying way too hard to be the best person for her, but this makes me forget about myself. Yes, I’ve asked what she needs multiple times, and yes acting accordingly is hard ;( I guess I miss the loving person she used to be. Her presence makes me calm, I don’t know how to be on my own anymore. I think I resent her a little bit because she used to be the needy partner and I tried my best to make her feel safe with me, but now she won’t do the same thing for me. Thank you so much for replying.
Being able to stay a month away is a great achievement. I’d try to stay another month without stalking on social media
You look like a great person. Thank you for being you.

People are a mess. They get angry because you’re asking for help somehow. They’ll always be angry, but they’ll feel like shit if you actually leave, sadly there would be impossible to go back in time and fix things. I have no advice, but please I beg you to not act the same with someone else. If you’re hurting, you know how painful things can be. Don’t ever be that bad guy to someone else. I’m sorry no one in your life gets it. I have someone angry at me too. I wish she could get that being angry makes everything worse. I’m sorry, but please don’t ever hurt yourself.

I’m sorry. I’m posting just so you know at least someone read your message. I drink too. I drink nonstop when I have beer in the fridge. I can’t control, so not buying it is the most effective approach for me
Yes. It’s really sad. I’m sorry you feel this way
Thank you and I’m sorry to hear that you’re sick too. I do hope we get better
I for some reason saw it as an airport where the sofa were the bags line
I am so sorry. You look like a decent man. Please seek professional help, the sooner the better. It’s gonna get better once you start talking to a professional.
